intro: Capture reads a photo or file of a bill or receipt for you to check, then makes a draft. Nothing is posted until you say so: the draft goes through its own submit and approval like any other.
start: Press New capture and photograph or upload a supplier bill.
Check what was read beside the original, and make the draft bill.
Set up the capture address in Settings, so suppliers' emailed bills arrive here by themselves.

articles.title: Have a bill or receipt read for you
articles.summary: Photograph or upload it, check what was read beside the original, then make the draft bill or expense claim.

steps.rest: On a phone, use Take a photo. Elsewhere, Upload a file, drop a file here or Choose from Drive.
Supplier bill or Expense receipt, or let Clafina decide.

steps.lead: Wait for it to be read.
steps.rest: The row shows the step it is at, and you are told when it is ready. You can leave the page.

steps.lead: Press Check on a row that is ready.
steps.rest: The original is on the left, with boxes on what was read.

steps.lead: Look at the fields in amber.
steps.rest: Each says why it needs a look. Press a box to see its field, and correct anything that is wrong.
or Make the draft expense claim. You open, check and submit the draft from there.

tips: The original stays attached to the bill it made, so anyone checking later sees what it came from.
Your corrections are remembered for your organisation only, so the next bill from that supplier needs fewer.
Most create forms also have Fill from a document, which fills that form from a file for you to check and save.

articles.title: Email bills straight into Capture
articles.summary: Make a capture address and forward bills to it. They appear in Capture, read and waiting for you.
before: You need permission to manage Capture, and an email channel that reads a mailbox (Communication › Channels).

steps.rest: that reads your mail. Give an address of your own if you want one.
Press Copy the address to share it with your team and suppliers.
PDFs and pictures attached are read, and it appears in Capture in about a minute.

tips: The address is also shown on an empty Capture page.
Who may email documents in, and which kinds are drafted without anyone opening them, are in Capture's settings.
Stop taking mail turns the address off.

articles.title: When Capture is not sure what a document is
articles.summary: Say which form a document is for, deal with a possible copy, or reject what should not be in the books.

steps.rest: When it was not sure what the document is, it says so and waits for you. The list's filter shows these as Not sorted yet.

steps.lead: Choose the kind of document and press Read it as this.
steps.rest: It is read again as that.

steps.lead: Check a warning that it may be a copy.
steps.rest: This may already be in the books shows the bill like it. If it is a different one, press This is not a duplicate to go on.
if it should not be in the books. Nothing is made from it.

tips: A row that Could not be read says what to do next. Try again, or capture a clearer photo.
Open in its form, filled opens the document's own form with what was read, for you to finish and save.
